definitions.explanation: The indigenous religion of Japan, centered on the worship of kami (spirits/deities).

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{神道|しんとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{儀式|ぎしき}→儀式：00071_gishiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The wedding ceremony was held with Shinto rites.

examples.japanese: {神道|しんとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{固有|こゆう}→固有：05615_koyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{宗教|しゅうきょう}→宗教：03208_shuukyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Shinto is the indigenous religion of Japan.

examples.japanese: {神道|しんとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{参拝|さんぱい}した→参拝する：15627_sanpaisuru⟧。

notes:
{神道|しんとう} is Japan's indigenous spiritual tradition.

RELATED WORDS:
- {神道|しんとう}{式|しき}: Shinto-style (ceremony)
- ⟦{神主|かんぬし}→神主：16732_kannushi⟧: Shinto priest
- ⟦{巫女|みこ}→巫女：12408_miko⟧: shrine maiden
- ⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧ (kami): spirits/deities
- ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧: Shinto shrine
- ⟦{鳥居|とりい}→鳥居：05956_torii⟧: shrine gate (torii)
- ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧: festivals

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Many Japanese practice both {神道|しんとう} and ⟦{仏教|ぶっきょう}→仏教：11428_bukkyou⟧ (Buddhism)
- Shinto-style weddings (⟦{神前式|しんぜんしき}→神前式：28943_shinzenshiki⟧) are one traditional choice
- Funerals typically follow ⟦{仏教|ぶっきょう}→仏教：11428_bukkyou⟧ traditions

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with ⟦{浸透|しんとう}→浸透：07593_shintou⟧ (permeation, infiltration), which has the same reading.
